fusions.name: Stoop and Steal
fusions.desc: Swoops up to 7 tiles to the target and deals 12 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pecking Order
fusions.desc: A diving peck that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the end of its reach, and heals you for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Morsel Drop
fusions.desc: Hops 2 tiles and restores 12 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, 1% more for each 1% of cast speed you have. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Crumb Trail
fusions.desc: As you cover ground, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
